name: Organic Japanese Sencha Kagoshima
desc:
Sencha is the classic green tea among Japanese tea varieties, essential in every household.

Sencha tea boasts a relatively high caffeine content, yet the caffeine is bound differently than in black tea or coffee, allowing for slower metabolism. The presence of the amino acid L-theanine further enhances its tolerance. Consequently, green tea provides a stimulating and invigorating experience without overwhelming the body.

name: Peach Bloom
desc:
These artfully blooming tea balls combine the elegance of white tea with the enticing aroma of ripe peaches.

White tea is appreciated for its gentle effects and numerous health benefits. Rich in antioxidants, particularly polyphenols, white tea can help reduce cellular damage and support heart health. The tea’s anti-inflammatory properties strengthen the immune system and contribute to overall well-being.

name: Sapphire Jasmine Needle
desc:
All the sophistication and elegance of a classic white Silver Needle tea with a dramatic visual twist. The Butterfly Pea plant, scientifically known as Clitoria ternatea, is renowned for its striking blue flowers.

In Ayurvedic medicine, Butterfly Pea is valued for its adaptogenic properties, which help to calm the body and reduce stress. Rich in antioxidants, particularly anthocyanins, the tea may help protect cells from oxidative damage and support heart health.

name: Rose White
desc:
This elegant white rose tea pairs premium Chinese Bai Mu Dan white tea with fragrant rose petals and rosebuds.

White tea is highly valued for its soothing qualities and numerous health benefits. With its mild flavour and low caffeine content, it offers a subtle yet refreshing lift. Rich in antioxidants, particularly polyphenols, white tea can help protect cells from damage and support heart health. Its anti-inflammatory properties also help strengthen the immune system.

name: Velvet Salted Caramel
desc:
Salted caramel blends the luxurious sweetness of caramel with a hint of sea salt to create an exquisite taste experience.

Black tea contains antioxidants like polyphenols and flavonoids, which can strengthen the immune system and contribute to overall health. The caffeine in black tea stimulates circulation and metabolism, increases mental alertness, and improves concentration.

name: Rush Hour Berry
desc:
Fruit tea is a diverse and delightful category of tea, crafted entirely from dried fruits, flowers, herbs, and spices. Naturally free from caffeine, these teas are ideal for any time of day—whether you prefer a revitalising drink in the morning or a soothing, warming cup in the evening.

Rush Hour Berry combines the antioxidant and immune-boosting benefits of elderflower, hibiscus, and rosehip, all rich in Vitamin C. Meanwhile, peppermint and sweet blackberry leaves impart a refreshing touch, making this tea a revitalising choice for both body and mind.

name: Organic Matcha Cocktail Grade - Kagoshima
desc:
Kagoshima is a diverse area with a mild, sub-tropical environment, dotted with volcanoes and mountains. With good rainfall, it is a key centre for the cultivation of Japanese produce, including teas gaining acknowledgement for their quality and taste.

This ultra-healthy beverage contains the nutritional equivalent of 10 cups of regular green tea and has been dubbed the ‘ultimate superfood’ by nutrition experts. The tea contains catechins, carotenes and vitamins A, B, C and E. The green powder is rich in the amino acid L-theanine, which promotes relaxation and reduces stress while providing long-lasting alertness.

name: Matcha Iri Genmaicha
desc:
Mild Japanese green tea blended with buttery Matcha and roasted brown rice.

Genmaicha contains a moderate amount of caffeine compared to other Matcha variants and is rich in antioxidants, which are beneficial for overall health. The green powder is high in the amino acid L-theanine, promoting relaxation, reducing stress, and providing long-lasting alertness.
